show.description: A single mother raises three remarkable sons while facing constant challenges from her family. When she returns home for her father’s seventieth birthday, she is met with coldness and hostility from her father and younger sisters. Refusing to be broken, she stands tall against their prejudice and finds her own path to happiness.
